sections.title: Bosses
sections.note: One from each of the seven bosses before Bellum.

items.name: Blaaz's Heart Container
items.howTo: Defeat Blaaz, the boss of the Temple of Fire.

items.name: Cyclok's Heart Container
items.howTo: Defeat Cyclok, the boss of the Temple of Wind.

items.name: Crayk's Heart Container
items.howTo: Defeat Crayk, the boss of the Temple of Courage.

items.name: Cubus Sisters's Heart Container
items.howTo: Defeat the Cubus Sisters, the boss of the Ghost Ship.

items.name: Dongorongo's Heart Container
items.howTo: Defeat Dongorongo, the boss of the Goron Temple.

items.name: Gleeok's Heart Container
items.howTo: Defeat Gleeok, the boss of the Temple of Ice.

items.name: Eox's Heart Container
items.howTo: Defeat Eox, the boss of Mutoh's Temple.

sections.title: Shops & Mini-games
sections.note: Six more from shops, mini-games and fishing.

items.name: Nyeve's challenge
items.howTo: Board Nyeve's ship, the Prince of Red Lions, in the Northwestern Sea, talk to him twice and hit him 100 times before he hits you three times.
items.notes: Back off when he spins his weapon, then strike after his thrust.

items.name: Shooting Range
items.howTo: Score 2,000 points or more at Romanos's Shooting Range (20 Rupees a go), open after the Temple of Courage.
items.notes: Hit ghosts in a row for the multiplier; hitting a girl target breaks the streak.

items.name: Masked Ship
items.howTo: Buy it from Beedle's Assistant on the Masked Ship for 1,500 Rupees. The Masked Ship replaces Beedle's Shop Ship from 10pm to midnight on weekdays and 10am to noon on weekends, by the DS clock.

items.name: The Neptoona
items.howTo: Catch a Neptoona at a black swordfish-shaped fish shadow and show it to the Old Wayfarer.
items.notes: Neptoona appears only after you've shown him a Rusty Swordfish. The fish are in Sidequests.
items.after: After showing the Old Wayfarer a Rusty Swordfish

items.name: Island Shop
items.howTo: After the Goron Temple, and once you've bought the Bomb Bag, Quiver and Bombchu Bag upgrades, buy it for 2,000 Rupees at the Mercay, Molida or Goron Island Shop.
items.notes: Only one shop sells it; once bought, the others stop. Zelda Wiki names only the Quiver and Bombchu Bag as the condition.

items.name: Treasure Maze: Expert
items.howTo: Clear the Treasure Maze's Expert level (100 Rupees): strike 14 Boing Statues in 120 seconds, then open the chest. Beginner and Normal come first.
